tests.title: Battery cold start reaches usable Home
tests.objective: Verify normal startup from fully powered-off state.
setup: An onboarded Go V1 unit with sufficient battery charge; tracking is idle and no diagnostic or update is running.

steps.action: Record whether USB is initially connected, then prepare for the battery start below.
steps.expected_result: The initial USB state is recorded.

steps.action: Disconnect USB, hold Power until Powered off is painted, release Power, wait 10 seconds, then press Power to start.
steps.expected_result: Getting Ready completes a full screen refresh without stopping on a partial frame.

steps.action: Observe Home for up to five minutes from Power press.
steps.expected_result: PM2.5, CO2, temperature, humidity, TVOC, NOx, pressure and battery readings become available; warming fields are dashes before they become valid.
evidence: Record version and a Home photo; video a stalled or incomplete refresh.

cleanup: Restore the recorded USB connection state after reaching normal Home.

tests.title: Getting Started ignores short Enter
tests.objective: Verify that an incomplete hold cannot complete onboarding.
setup: An onboarded Go V1 release-test unit with expendable routes, charts, settings and bonds; tracking is idle and no diagnostic or update is running.

steps.action: Hold BOOT at least two seconds to factory-reset; wait for Getting Started.
steps.expected_result: The guide has Scan for guide and Hold Enter to start.

steps.action: Tap Enter once. Allow the resulting screen refresh to finish.
steps.expected_result: Getting Started stays open.

steps.action: Disconnect USB, hold Power until Powered off is painted, release Power, wait 10 seconds, then press Power to start.
steps.expected_result: Getting Started appears again; onboarding was not saved.

cleanup: Finish onboarding with a one-second Enter hold; original data was intentionally erased.

tests.title: A custom 17-second interval survives another setting change and restart
tests.objective: Verify exact representation and intentional replacement of custom cadence.
setup: An onboarded Go V1 unit with sufficient battery charge; tracking is idle and no diagnostic or update is running.
Computer with curl on a controllable 2.4 GHz WPA2 LAN; the test unit already has working saved credentials for that LAN.

A writable evidence directory for this case; replace <run-dir> with its absolute path. Commands run from the repository root at the tested revision. Replace placeholders before running and quote paths containing spaces.

steps.action: Record the current operating mode, lock state, USB connection state and measurement interval and GPS mode. Select Main Menu > Operating Mode > Stationary; unlock with a short Power press if needed. Settings paths below start at Main Menu > Settings.
steps.expected_result: Stationary is selected and the original values are recorded for cleanup.

steps.action:
Create <run-dir> as this case’s evidence directory. Read the assigned address from the router association list. Set AGO_URL to this unit, replacing the example IP, and save its configuration:
AGO_URL='http://192.168.1.20'
curl --max-time 5 -sS "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config" -o <run-dir>/config-original.json
Replace <run-dir> with this case’s writable evidence directory. Record About Device serial as <serial>.
steps.expected_result: Saved Wi-Fi is connected and the original GET Config returns a complete JSON object.

steps.action:
Enable local authority:
curl --max-time 5 -i -X PUT "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"configurationControl":"local"}'
Read back with curl --max-time 5 -sS "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config". Poll for at most 20 seconds from acceptance before continuing.
steps.expected_result: The PUT returns empty HTTP 202; GET Config reports configurationControl=local.

steps.action:
Submit:
curl --max-time 5 -i -X PUT "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"cloudConnection":false}'
Then read curl --max-time 5 -sS "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config". Poll for at most 20 seconds from HTTP acceptance.
steps.expected_result: Empty HTTP 202 is followed by GET Config containing the requested values.

steps.action:
Submit:
curl --max-time 5 -i -X PUT "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"measurementInterval":17}'
Then read curl --max-time 5 -sS "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config". Poll for at most 20 seconds from HTTP acceptance.
steps.expected_result: Empty HTTP 202 is followed by GET Config containing the requested values.

steps.action: Open Settings > Operations > Measure Int. Change GPS to Always Off and reopen Measure Int.
steps.expected_result: Operations shows 17s; selected Custom (17s) precedes fixed 3s, 10s, 30s, 60s, 5m, 15m, 1h. Changing GPS preserves 17.

tests.objective: Verify this trigger reaches a successful sensor calibration.
setup: An onboarded Go V1 release-test unit with expendable routes, charts, settings and bonds; tracking is idle and no diagnostic or update is running.
Outdoor air away from people, vehicles and combustion; the fitted CO2 capability supports manual calibration.
Computer with curl on a controllable 2.4 GHz WPA2 LAN; the test unit already has working saved credentials for that LAN.
USB cable and a serial terminal configured for the native USB Serial/JTAG port at 115200 baud, with timestamped logging. Sleep tests require automatic reconnection after USB re-enumeration.
Outdoor calibration location within test Wi-Fi coverage.

A writable evidence directory for this case; replace <run-dir> with its absolute path. Commands run from the repository root at the tested revision. Replace placeholders before running and quote paths containing spaces.

steps.action: Record the current operating mode, lock state, USB connection state and configuration authority. Select Main Menu > Operating Mode > Stationary; unlock with a short Power press if needed. Settings paths below start at Main Menu > Settings.
steps.expected_result: Stationary is selected and the original values are recorded for cleanup.

steps.action:
Create <run-dir> as this case’s evidence directory. Read the assigned address from the router association list. Set AGO_URL to this unit, replacing the example IP, and save its configuration:
AGO_URL='http://192.168.1.20'
curl --max-time 5 -sS "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config" -o <run-dir>/config-original.json
Replace <run-dir> with this case’s writable evidence directory. Record About Device serial as <serial>.
steps.expected_result: Saved Wi-Fi is connected and the original GET Config returns a complete JSON object.

steps.action:
Enable local authority:
curl --max-time 5 -i -X PUT "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"configurationControl":"local"}'
Read back with curl --max-time 5 -sS "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config". Poll for at most 20 seconds from acceptance before continuing.
steps.expected_result: The PUT returns empty HTTP 202; GET Config reports configurationControl=local.

steps.action:
Submit:
curl --max-time 5 -i -X PUT "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"cloudConnection":false}'
Then read curl --max-time 5 -sS "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config". Poll for at most 20 seconds from HTTP acceptance.
steps.expected_result: Empty HTTP 202 is followed by GET Config containing the requested values.

steps.action: Keep the sensor measuring in the outdoor calibration air for at least three minutes.
steps.expected_result: The warmed unit is stationary in the calibration environment.

steps.action: Run: curl --max-time 5 -i -X POST "$AGO_URL/api/v1/actions/calibrate-co2"
steps.expected_result: The HTTP response is empty 200; this establishes request admission only.

steps.action: Observe until 90 seconds after the request.
steps.expected_result: Calibrating CO2... is followed by CO2 cal. done; the serial or BLE completion reports success.
evidence: Record the physical completion and command result.

cleanup: Allow an in-flight calibration to finish before moving the device. Calibration changes its physical baseline and cannot be undone by restoring configuration.

If the case left Stationary, return Stationary and update AGO_URL from the router first. Enable local authority with curl --max-time 5 -i -X PUT "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"configurationControl":"local"}' and confirm it with GET Config before restoring fields. Restore configurationControl from config-original.json using individual PUT /api/v1/config requests: curl --max-time 5 -i -X PUT "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"field":original_value}' (replace field and original_value with the saved field/value). Poll GET Config for at most 20 seconds after each accepted write. Restore the recorded cloudConnection next; restore configurationControl last, then original mode, lock and USB state. If a request unexpectedly changed another field, restore it too and record the failure.

setup: An onboarded Go V1 release-test unit with expendable routes, charts, settings and bonds; tracking is idle and no diagnostic or update is running.

steps.action: Record the current operating mode, lock state, USB connection state and temperature unit. Select Main Menu > Operating Mode > Stationary; unlock with a short Power press if needed. Settings paths below start at Main Menu > Settings.

steps.action:
Create <run-dir> as this case’s evidence directory. Read the assigned address from the router association list. Set AGO_URL to this unit, replacing the example IP, and save its configuration:
AGO_URL='http://192.168.1.20'
curl --max-time 5 -sS "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config" -o <run-dir>/config-original.json
Replace <run-dir> with this case’s writable evidence directory. Record About Device serial as <serial>.
steps.expected_result: Saved Wi-Fi is connected and the original GET Config returns a complete JSON object.

steps.action:
Enable local authority:
curl --max-time 5 -i -X PUT "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"configurationControl":"local"}'
Read back with curl --max-time 5 -sS "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config". Poll for at most 20 seconds from acceptance before continuing.
steps.expected_result: The PUT returns empty HTTP 202; GET Config reports configurationControl=local.

steps.action:
Submit:
curl --max-time 5 -i -X PUT "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"cloudConnection":false}'
Then read curl --max-time 5 -sS "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config". Poll for at most 20 seconds from HTTP acceptance.
steps.expected_result: Empty HTTP 202 is followed by GET Config containing the requested values.

steps.action: Read the recorded temperatureUnit value. Use "f" as the target, or "c" if it already equals that target.
steps.expected_result: The target differs from the original value.

steps.action:
PUT the selected target using this example (substitute the alternate when needed):
curl --max-time 5 -i -X PUT "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"temperatureUnit":"f"}'
Poll curl --max-time 5 -sS "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config" for at most 20 seconds.
steps.expected_result: Empty HTTP 202 is followed by the selected temperatureUnit in Config.

steps.action: Disconnect USB, hold Power until Powered off is painted, release Power, wait 10 seconds, then press Power to start. Reconnect Stationary and read curl --max-time 5 -sS "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config".
steps.expected_result: The selected temperatureUnit persists; a changed sensor setting in Config is not by itself proof of a completed calibration or physical learning cycle.

cleanup: If the case left Stationary, return Stationary and update AGO_URL from the router first. Enable local authority with curl --max-time 5 -i -X PUT "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"configurationControl":"local"}' and confirm it with GET Config before restoring fields. Restore temperatureUnit from config-original.json using individual PUT /api/v1/config requests: curl --max-time 5 -i -X PUT "$AGO_URL/api/v1/config" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"field":original_value}' (replace field and original_value with the saved field/value). Poll GET Config for at most 20 seconds after each accepted write. Restore the recorded cloudConnection next; restore configurationControl last, then original mode, lock and USB state. If a request unexpectedly changed another field, restore it too and record the failure.

steps.action: Provision AP A. Turn A off, cold-start and provision AP B when setup opens. Restore A; do not reset between provisioning the two.

cleanup: Restore both APs and leave the dedicated unit Portable.

steps.action: Record the current operating mode, lock state and USB connection state. Select Main Menu > Operating Mode > Portable; unlock with a short Power press if needed. Settings paths below start at Main Menu > Settings.

steps.action: Record the device Bluetooth name/address and its saved network’s device IP from the router. Select Main Menu > Operating Mode > Stationary.

steps.action: Within 30 seconds, inspect the router association, join that LAN and run curl --max-time 5 -i http://<device-ip>/api/v1/measures. Scan Bluetooth with clients closed.

cleanup: If interrupted, exit the open test/menu and stop only this case’s test route. Restore the recorded operating mode, operating mode, lock state and USB connection state. Verify the setting values; record any restoration that fails.
